messages.subject: Can someone help me with this ODE case?
parts:
I am a little confused with the integrate_ode case in stan reference. I tried my best to write a piece of ode code but it fail to run.
Can someone help me figure what's wrong with my code? Thanks!


My case is:
Given dy / dt = function(y, theta1, theta2),
and y(t=0) = 0
Solve an array of y, with an array of t.

My code is:
function{
    real[] diff_y(real t, real f=y, real[] para){
real dydt;
dydt <- 2*pi()/para[0] * (1+para[1]*cos(y))^2 / (1-para[1]^2)^1.5;
return dydt;
}

    real[]    calc_rv(int Nt, real[] t, real[] para){
                real y[Nt];

                y <- integrate_ode(diff_y, 0, 0, t, para);
               return y;
    }

}

parts:
Same answer as last time.

The ODE system function has to have the exact same signature as
the example in the manual. By that, I mean exactly the same
argument types in exactly the same sequence, and exactly the same
return type.

Your function diff_y doesn't have the same signature, uses a syntax
f = y that's not part of Stan in the argument list, and tries to return
a real value as an array.

- Bob
